item.title: Nodoguro: The San'in Coast's Luxury Fish — Guide
item.description: Nodoguro, the blackthroat seaperch (akamutsu), is among the most luxurious fish in Japanese cuisine, and the Sea of Japan coast of Shimane is one of its finest sources. Named for the black throat inside its red-tinged body, it has an unusually fatty, delicate white flesh so rich that it is nicknamed ‘the white toro of the sea’. It commands very high prices at auction and is treated as a special-occasion fish.

item.title: Nodoguro: The Prized Blackthroat Seaperch of the Sea of Japan — Guide
item.description: Nodoguro, or blackthroat seaperch, is one of the most sought-after fish caught along the Sea of Japan coast near Ishikawa, prized among chefs and diners for its rich, buttery fat content and delicate flavour that intensifies when the fish is grilled. Because catches are limited and demand is high, nodoguro commands premium prices and is often featured as a highlight ingredient on kaiseki menus, though it’s also served more simply as sashimi or nigiri sushi at restaurants and market stalls throughout Kanazawa.
